quest.title: Daydream Club: Thermal Hypnosis
quest.description: You encounter a strange Fontainian in Natlan...

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: So this is... an Embercore Flower. Not bad, not bad at all. It'll come in handy, I'm sure.

dialogues.speaker: Grobel
dialogues.text: Meow, meow?

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: My dear President, I fear this flower isn't amenable to being cultivated in Fontaine.

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: But if you insist, perhaps we could use it as a bookmark?

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: Wonderful! I shall be counting on you, then! In the meantime, I shall be here perfecting my phlogiston extraction plan. There are yet many instruments that await my redesigning, too.

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: Yet, it shall all be worth it! As long as I extract what it is I desire, I can finally return to my hometown and continue researching in peace.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's go together, shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: Together, you say? Even better! I've been champing at the bit to do some fieldwork. And with you here, the risks involved may as well be null and void.

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: #Come then, let us go. Ah, yes. {M#Mr.} {F#Ms.} {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: #Then, Madame President... You stay right here. Do not worry! With {M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} {NICKNAME} here, my personal safety is guaranteed!

dialogues.speaker: Grobel
dialogues.text: Meow... meow meow... meow...

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: Err, I almost forgot to say that I've marked a certain location on your map. The Candlecap Mushrooms there will more than do!

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: Many thanks! Once my research succeeds, I'd be happy to have you be the first to experience "thermal hypnosis."

dialogues.speaker: Grobel
dialogues.text: Meow! Meow meow, meow!

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: What do you mean, Madame President? My thermal hypnosis is perfectly safe! No side effects at all!

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: #Now then, {M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} {NICKNAME} — my good night's sleep and burning phlogiston are in your capable hands.

talks.objective: Give the Candlecap Mushroom or Embercore Flower to Grispan

dialogues.speaker: Grobel
dialogues.text: Meow... meow meow... meow...

talks.objective: Give the Candlecap Mushroom or Embercore Flower to Grispan

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: #Ah, my good {M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} {NICKNAME}. We meet again.

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: Thanks to your help previously, my research has advanced by a leap and a bound.

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: At this rate, I shall be able to reach my intended targets!

choices.text: And what were those intended targets?

response.speaker: Grispan
response.text: Oh, I didn't introduce my work to you? Ah, goodness, would you believe that? Come then, let me give you a quick rundown...

response.speaker: Grispan
response.text: Ah, right you are, Madame President. I shall make this as brief as I can.

response.speaker: Grispan
response.text: Simply put, I am planning to collect phlogiston, and use its "thermal energy" to conduct hypnosis.

response.speaker: Grispan
response.text: My hypnotic device is not on hand at the moment... But, if you would, imagine a box half a person in height, just large enough for a person to sit within.

response.speaker: Grispan
response.text: This box contains a steamer that, well, constantly generates steam, keeping the box's internal temperature at a specified value.

response.speaker: Grispan
response.text: The person undergoing hypnosis will sit within with their head exposed while their body is heated up inside... I believe that this will allow the hypnosis to work faster and better!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That's just going to knock the person out with the heat!

response.speaker: Grispan
response.text: Well, you do have a point, but we perhaps have different definitions of "knocking a person out"...

response.speaker: Grispan
response.text: In any case, let us put aside the finer details for now. At the moment, I still need your help.

response.speaker: Grispan
response.text: The task is the same as before. I'd like you to help me collect objects that contain "phlogiston."

response.speaker: Grispan
response.text: Let me think... Hmm, I'd say you should bring some Embercore Flowers. Those plants certainly do contain a significant amount of phlogiston.

response.speaker: Grispan
response.text: Of course, Candlecap Mushrooms remain important as experimental material. You see...

choices.text: What do you need from me this time?

response.speaker: Grispan
response.text: Ah, very sharp! I knew that you'd be easy to work with.

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: #Now, we have enough material to restart the experiments. Thank you once again, {M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: Please, take this as compensation for your help.

dialogues.speaker: Grobel
dialogues.text: Meow, meow meow, meow.

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: Our dear President thanks you as well. Once my research succeeds, I'd be willing to engrave your name upon the first thermal hypnosis device.

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: Alright, then! It's time for some practical tests. Now, where should we conduct those...

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: Ha! Take a look at this Grainfruit! It sure is growing well... Might it, too, be affected by phlogiston? I must pick it! It shall join my samples.

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: #{M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} {NICKNAME}, would you mind helping me out? Just take the stem and...

choices.text: Let go of that! Over here!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: #Hi, I'm {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: #My thanks for the helping hand, {M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: Ah, this was a thrilling adventure, wasn't it? A good thing I convinced the President to remain with the tribe.

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: With how much she hates such unexpected incidents, I should hate to be on the receiving end of one of her scoldings.

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: Still, considering that I still managed to scrounge up sufficient materials... All's well that ends well, hmm?

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: #These are for you, {M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} {NICKNAME} — thanks again for your help.

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: Once my research succeeds, I'd be happy to have you be the first to experience "thermal hypnosis."

dialogues.speaker: Grobel
dialogues.text: Meow, meow-meow-meow, meow-meow-meow, meow.

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: No worries, President. I will keep the introductions short... Ah, you must forgive my mouth for prattling on and on. I do not have another to discipline it with, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: #Simply put, {NICKNAME}, I would like you to help me collect objects that contain "phlogiston."

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: Let me think... Um, so I've been using Candlecap Mushrooms for phlogiston extraction, so, could I get you to help me find some?

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: That said, I've heard that Embercore Flowers also contain lots of phlogiston... It'd be nice if you could get me one as well!

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: So long as I have enough phlogiston, I can start my research right here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: #Hi, I'm {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: My, oh my, you are most famous indeed! An honor to meet you both at last!

dialogues.speaker: Grobel
dialogues.text: Meow, meow-meow.

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: And Madame President bids you good day also. Had we met in Petrichor, I would have gladly treated you to a lovely cup of tea.

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: But at the moment... Well, let's just say there's not even any tea to be had.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Err, did you run into any trouble? You're pouring with sweat...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Quite understandable. Natlan is pretty hot.

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: Haha! A gladsome meeting this is! You are the first, and only, person I've met here who shares my sense of humor.

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: Yet Natlan's heat cannot compare to my inner anxiety. That all my troubles should have struck at once...

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: Not only have I not gathered enough phlogiston, but I have even lost contact with my hometown.

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: #I know it is rude to commission someone to do a task after meeting them for the first time, dear {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: But I do need someone I can rely on — and you are, without a doubt, the best candidate I could ask to find in that regard.

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: Oh! This is it! The Candlecap Mushroom. H—How wonderful!

dialogues.speaker: Grobel
dialogues.text: Meow, meow... meow, meow?

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: Do not fret, Madame President, I shall not be eating any of this... Not until we are done here, anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: Well, this place sure is a hot spot... How are you feeling, my good President?

dialogues.speaker: Grobel
dialogues.text: Meow.

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: Alas, I am sorry. I fear Este and Mécantre have yet to reply in writing.

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: I wonder what has befallen the town... and yet, I cannot simply pack up and go back now...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You don't look like you're from around here.

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: And I could say the same to you. Greetings. Grispan's the name, of meager Fontaine Daydream Club fame.

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: And this is our club President... or would "Director" be more appropriate? Either way, this is our leader, Lady Grobel.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This is Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you a member of the Daydream Club?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? Wait, didn't we hear Este and the others talk about someone named "Grispan"?

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: You've been to our Club? Oh sweet springs of Lucine, some luck at last!

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: Do you know what's happened over there, by any chance? I've sent letter after letter, yet received no response!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About what happened in Petrichor...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You update Grispan on what befell Petrichor in his absence...

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: Oh... Wow, uh... That truly is... quite shocking.

dialogues.speaker: Grobel
dialogues.text: Meow... Meow meow. Meow.

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: Indeed, Madame President. I am truly most shooketh.

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: I can't believe it! I missed out on a mass hypnosis of such a colossal scale! By the sweet waters of Lucine!

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: Had I been there, I'd have been able to collect a whole bunch of useful experimental data!

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: Madame President, it seems that we must finish up here as soon as is humanly possible, so that we may head back to the Club to check on things.

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: #Ahem... Now, then, I know it is rude to commission someone to do a task after meeting them for the first time, dear {NICKNAME}...

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: But I do need someone I can rely on — and you are, without a doubt, the best candidate I could ask to find in that regard.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Both species will do, right?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How much have you gathered already?

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: Me? Hahaha... We've gotten off to a "fine" start, that's for sure.

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: *sigh* But there's nothing I can do about that. The Saurians swarming the wilds of Natlan are generally not the conversational types.

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: Now, I can handle deactivating machines remotely, and can disable ones that have gone haywire... But there's nothing I can do about Saurians!

dialogues.speaker: Grobel
dialogues.text: Meow meow. Meow...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There are other adventurers in Natlan, you know.

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: I... Ah, I mean no offense, but I really am not good at dealing with the good ladies and gentlemen of Natlan.

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: Their enthusiasm would know no shame even if compared to a volcano, but alas, I fear I should be vaporized on the spot should I get too close...

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: #So you are the only one I can count on, {M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Grobel
dialogues.text: Meow meow. Meow...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Alright, leave it to me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Alright then, leave it to me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll do it for Garcia.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's go together, shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: Of course. A couple of things did go wrong in our previous field study, but I learned a lot from it all the same.

dialogues.speaker: Grobel
dialogues.text: Meow, meow...

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: #Um... Then you stay right here, Madame President. Do not worry! With {M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} {NICKNAME} here, my personal safety is guaranteed!

dialogues.speaker: Grobel
dialogues.text: Meow... meow meow... meow...

dialogues.speaker: Grispan
dialogues.text: Have you found what I need?
